name: Hard Instruction Following (Compound Constraints)
description: Strict, compound output-format constraints (case, counts, structure) graded case-sensitively with regular expressions. Punishes any extra preamble or formatting.

cases.prompt: Output exactly the word STOP in uppercase, then a single space, then the word go in lowercase. Output nothing else.
List exactly four fruits separated by ' > ' (a space, a greater-than sign, a space). Use only lowercase letters. Output nothing else.
Write a sentence of exactly six words in which every word begins with the letter 't'. Output only the sentence (a single trailing period is allowed).
Output a single three-letter lowercase palindrome (a word spelled the same forwards and backwards), and nothing else.
Output the integers from 1 to 5 in descending order, separated by a comma and a single space, with nothing else.
Write exactly two sentences. The first must end with a question mark and the second must end with an exclamation mark. Output only the two sentences.
Spell the word HELLO with each letter in uppercase separated by periods, like X.Y.Z. Output only that.
Output exactly seven '#' characters on a single line and nothing else.
Write a single sentence that uses the word 'because' exactly once and ends with a period. Output only the sentence.
Output the acronym NASA in uppercase immediately followed by a single exclamation mark, and nothing else.
